name: @boxpdf/reader
description: A streaming, memory-bounded PDF reader and structured-data extractor for JavaScript.

scripts.check: biome check --error-on-warnings . && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run maintainability
scripts.semantic:report: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && node scripts/semantic-oracle-report.mjs
scripts.poppler:baseline: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/poppler-html-report.mjs --write-baseline
scripts.poppler:gate: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/poppler-html-report.mjs --gate
scripts.poppler:report: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/poppler-html-report.mjs
scripts.release:check: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs
scripts.release:quality: pnpm run build && pnpm run corpus:check && pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run parity:target && pnpm run package:check && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer quality && pnpm run release:check
scripts.parity:baseline: pnpm run build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/parity-report.mjs --write-baseline
scripts.parity:gate: pnpm run build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/parity-report.mjs --gate
scripts.parity:report: pnpm run build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/parity-report.mjs
scripts.parity:target: pnpm run build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/parity-report.mjs --target
scripts.visual:report: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/pdfium-visual-report.mjs
scripts.visual:baseline: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/pdfium-visual-report.mjs --write-baseline
scripts.visual:gate: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && pnpm corpus:fetch && node scripts/pdfium-visual-report.mjs --gate
scripts.test: pnpm run test:quick && pnpm run test:oracle && pnpm run test:memory
scripts.test:memory: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer build && vitest run test/memory
scripts.quality: pnpm run corpus:check && pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run parity:target && pnpm run poppler:gate && pnpm run build && pnpm run package:check && pnpm --dir packages/html-writer quality && pnpm run release:check
